messages:
tess: Dropping a quick convo about the in-console docs panel — Figma here: https://figma.com/file/short. Main tradeoff: hover discoverability vs click stability for a11y.
mike: Click. Hover breaks on touch and is flaky with trackpads. Click gives us keyboard focus control.
ara: Agree click. Add aria-expanded and a visible focus ring. For SRs announce: 'Console docs panel: <topic>'.
tess: Linking strategy: fragment anchors (#caching) or query param (?src=panel)?
mike: Use fragment for human shareability, append ?src=panel before the hash for analytics. Example: /docs/console?src=panel#caching.
ara: CTA copy: contextual when possible ('See caching guide') else 'Open docs'. Also open links in new tab with rel="noopener" and aria-label mentioning new tab.
docs-bot: Note: docs heading IDs PR is scheduled: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/400.
tess: OK will update Figma, add icon for external docs, and file tickets for a11y checks. Thanks :thumbsup:
summary: Quick UX thread deciding click-to-open for the in-console docs panel, ARIA/focus requirements, fragment anchors + src param for telemetry, contextual CTA copy preference, external-link behavior, and next steps (figma update + a11y PR).
